blocks.text: The Crayola Ultimate Light Board is an innovative LED drawing board designed to spark your child’s creativity. This light-up drawing tablet features 3 mesmerizing light effects, 6 vibrant gel markers, and a removable tracing panel. It serves as both a drawing board and tracing pad, allowing your child to doodle and create intricate designs effortlessly. The LED lights illuminate each drawing with dazzling effects that make artwork come to life. Equipped with 6 Crayola Mini Washable Gel Markers, it’s perfect for doodling and crafting bold, colorful designs. The built-in kickstand ensures a comfortable drawing position, while the smart marker storage keeps everything organized—great for travel. The reusable drawing surface wipes clean with ease, making it ready for the next masterpiece. More than just a toy, this drawing tablet is an excellent addition to homeschool or classroom supplies, helping kids develop fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Whether for birthdays or holidays, the Crayola Ultimate Light Board makes a perfect Christmas gift for kids, excellent Christmas gifts for grandkids, and a fun holiday gift for boys and girls aged 6 and up. (3 AA batteries required—not included.) This product is ACMI Certified.

items.label: CRAYOLA ULTIMATE LIGHT BOARD
items.value: Features LED Drawing Board with 3 Light Effects, 1 Removable Tracing Panel, 6 Mini Washable Gel Markers, and 1 Built-In Kickstand (3 AA batteries required - not included).

items.label: LIGHT BOARD
items.value: Craft designs with 6 special effects gel markers and illuminate with 3 dazzling, long-lasting light effects! Refill with Crayola Washable Bold & Bright or Window Markers.

items.label: TRACING PAD
items.value: Remove the back panel and use the light board as a light-up tracing pad and doodle pad! Perfect for tracing and creating intricate diamond art.

items.label: GIFT FOR KIDS
items.value: Makes a great light-up toy, holiday, or birthday gift for boys and girls ages 6 and up.

items.label: CONVENIENT DESIGN
items.value: Lightweight, easy-to-carry art kit with built-in kickstand and smart marker storage for tidy travels.

items.label: REUSABLE DRAWING SURFACE
items.value: The reusable drawing surface cleans easily with one quick wipe and is easy to use.

items.label: KIDS ART SUPPLIES
items.value: Develop fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination with this versatile kids' drawing tablet for art projects.
